family_description: Rule-based surface rewrite + segmentation noise: bidirectional chat-register substitutions from a fixed neutral table (36 pairs), casing/punctuation jitter, message split/merge. Content-preserving; complements discourse noise.
dataset: PAN 2012 SPI training XML, author-disjoint 80/20 split
threat_model: test positives perturbed at inference; negatives clean; per-model thresholds calibrated once on clean test at FPR<=0.05 and held fixed

models.per_message_mean: LinearSVC message scores; conversation = mean (paper baseline, order-invariant)
models.per_message_max: LinearSVC message scores; conversation = max (order-invariant aggregation control)
models.per_message_top5: LinearSVC message scores; conversation = mean of top-5 (order-invariant aggregation control)
models.conv_concat: TF-IDF over concatenated conversation text + LinearSVC (order-invariant conversation classifier)
models.conv_mean: Unweighted mean of message TF-IDF vectors + LogisticRegression (order-invariant twin of the sequence model; differs from it only by removing position weights)
models.sequence: Position-weighted mean of message TF-IDF vectors + LogisticRegression (paper sequence model; order-sensitive via position weights)
models.sequence_shuffled: sequence model scored on order-shuffled messages (order-usage control, not a competing detector)
